column3: Hope of your calling is recast as hope “when you were called.”
The perfect man and measure of the stature of Christ’s fullness are compressed into maturing to Christ’s stature.
The dice-playing image is rendered “clever cunning.”
The body’s producing its growth is recast as “grows.”
“Sense of shame” specifies the unexpressed object of losing feeling.
“Surely” replaces if indeed; “of Him” replaces Him.
Former conduct is made a second object of put off; “its” is supplied with desires.
“To be like God” renders according to God.
Putting off falsehood is changed from a participle to a command.
“The one in need” supplies a person for need.
